French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /sɛ̃t/
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Homophones: ceinte, ceintes, Cynthe, saintes, Saintes

Noun

[edit]

sainte f (plural saintes, masculine saint)

  1. saintess; female equivalent of saint

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /saˈĩ.t͡ʃi/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /saˈĩ.t͡ʃi/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /saˈĩ.te/

Adjective

  1. outgoing, on its way out; soon to be no longer
